item.title: Marion police officer indicted on rape charges
item.description: MARION, Ohio (WCMH) -- A grand jury on Wednesday indicted a Marion police officer on charges including rape. Brendan Damron, 24, faces five charges -- two counts of rape, two counts of gross sexual imposition and one count of abduction, according to online court records. Damron was arrested in mid-February.
